main_text.l: In singulis autem libris hic ordo diligenter est obseruatus, vt cuiusque Orbis partis Regiones, Populi populorumque mores, Vrbes, Flumina, & Montes illustriores ex iisdem Poetis in certa capita distribuantur, atque describantur.

page.notes: The engraving shows the Hebrew tetragrammaton (יהוה) in a cloud above a tree with two figures; no text beyond the Hebrew name. Printer's date is printed as M. D. LXXX X, transcribed as printed. Stains and show-through omitted.
